hypothesis: Exact native logits with an explicitly surrogate suffix backward may yield useful descent directions for memory fusion parameters.
scope: Last-layer post-attention, last prefix position only; one next-token NLL; not recall, free generation, all-layer training or HTTP deployment.
target_selection: First non-whitespace C-tokenizer piece of next_token_text, one token only; no reference-answer prefix enters inference.
forward_gate: Bridged logits must be byte-exact native logits; zero and disabled injection must equal the ordinary C library; nonzero injection must affect native logits.
gradient_gate: Finite nonzero fusion gradients; for every case and backward variant, predicted descent must lower native NLL beyond 1e-6 and opposed direction must have higher NLL at at least 3 of 4 preregistered perturbations. Flat or ambiguous changes count as failures, not exclusions.
failure_action: Preserve every perturbation and reject promotion if any gate fails. Do not change perturbations, drop cases or start training.
limitations: Surrogate backward is not the exact derivative of a quantized C program. Passing only licenses further diagnostics, never a memory accuracy claim.
